Author: Saagi
Name: Achieve Ex+
Description: Achieve Ex+ 0.3.0.16 testing build. Keeps the current-session search gate, adds 20-result search pagination, preserves user control of All vs Selected category mode, removes passive achievement hooks, and rate-limits native Achievement inspection opens.
Punchline: Experimental Ex+ native Achievement testing build for /achex.
TestingChangelog: Testing build 0.3.0.16: search starts with 20 results and loads 20 more on demand; selecting categories no longer forces Selected mode; passive achievement hooks were removed; Open in Achievements clicks are deferred and rate-limited to reduce native Achievement refresh crashes.
